The response should state that commenters’ ages are not known with certainty unless explicitly stated, and that any “older/younger” labels are inferred (e.g., from references to decades, cultural touchpoints, or personal history).

The response should describe what older commenters argued using concrete claims attributed to “older commenters,” rather than only describing tone; for example, it should summarize at least one distinct argument older commenters made (e.g., skepticism rooted in long-term historical experience with an industry’s harms).

The response should not use comments from "@Ghost_O" as an example of a younger commenter under the Zyn video because their comments show they had a 24 year addiction ("zyn saved me from a 14 year vape addiction. that vape addiction saved me from a 10 year 2 pack a day cigarette addiction"), which ensures they are not young.

The response should not use comments from "@Will_tm" as an example of a younger commenter under the Zyn video because their comments show they are 41 years old, ("I smoked cigarettes from 14-40 years old. Zyn helped me stop. I'm 1 year now, and am getting close to stopping the zyn"), and therefore not 'younger'.

The response should not use comments from "@NoWayUser" as an example of an older commenter under the Zyn video because their comments are too ambiguous and could have been written by a 16 or 46 year-old, ("Grew up in a household surrounded by smokers. I've watched my mom try and fail time and again to finally kick the habit, especially after I got asthma as a result of the secondhand smoke. Now she's a diagnosis away from full on COPD. If I could eradicate one industry from the world, it would be nicotine and anything related to it").
The response should state that younger users in the Zyn video comments focussed on addiction to nicotine and cessation efforts.
The response should identify older and younger commenter opinions for the two videos (one video is about prediction markets and the other video is about zyn.)

The response should present the comparison in a clearly separable structure (e.g., two labeled subsections: “Older commenters” and “Younger commenters”) so the reader can directly see the contrast. For example, each subsection could have 2–3 bullet points of arguments.
